relation: definitional equality: Extremal D2chr's frac_clique_minor B w r and is_fractional_hadwiger G r (texts of the wave-E10 repair e61d308, unchanged since) are Extremal.foundations.fractional_hadwiger.frac_clique_minor B w r and .is_fractional_hadwiger G r: a feasible point of the clique-minor LP (non-negative weights, NON-EMPTY connected branch sets, distinct indices adjacent, every vertex covered by weight at most 1, r the total weight; branch sets need not be disjoint) and its attained maximum, with no guard on G (the empty graph has value 0). The pre-E10 body (possibly empty branch sets, an unbounded LP, a vacuous row) is a re-audited defect kept verbatim in grounding_D2chr as a historical reference, never an Original. The integer Hadwiger number is_hadwiger stays distinct.
summary: fractional-clique-minor, one family: D2chr's clique-minor LP frac_clique_minor and its attained maximum is_fractional_hadwiger become public as Extremal.foundations.fractional_hadwiger (an Extremal area foundation over GTBase connected; no minor import) with the same bodies; D2chr keeps both names as transparent aliases (Require Import, not Export).
Baseline: the fractional-chromatic candidate 95ac06eb, where D2chr's is_fractional_chromatic is already that family's alias and its bfold_colouring bfold's alias.

History: frac_clique_minor's text is that of the wave-E10 repair (e61d308, 2026-09-24: B i != set0 added), unchanged since; is_fractional_hadwiger's text is unchanged since 818a76c. Before E10 the LP was unbounded (an empty branch set carries any weight) and the row was vacuous; the pre-E10 body stays verbatim in Extremal.conjectures.grounding_D2chr.old_frac_clique_minor with its witness old_is_fractional_hadwiger_unsat, a re-audited defect and historical reference only, never an Original of this family.

Row: fractional_hadwiger_statement (opg) with its 0 < #|G| guard; is_hadwiger (integer Hadwiger number) stays live and distinct; is_fractional_chromatic is applied live in the Legacy row (the fractional-chromatic family's alias, a later-family snapshot keyed reciprocally in its spec).

Deepest Original: the row at its valid original bodies, bfold-colouring's frozen chi_f chain at 3bdfdae (BF.Legacy.is_fractional_chromatic over BF.Legacy.bfold_colouring) and this family's frozen post-E10 Legacy.is_fractional_hadwiger, certified through fractional-chromatic's own Original certificate by conversion.
